seo.keywords: flight booking software, flight management software, airline ticketing software, GDS booking engine, B2B flight booking portal, NDC booking system, travel agency ticketing software Bangladesh
overview: TravelSuite ERP is flight booking and ticketing software built for travel agencies, OTAs and B2B consolidators. It brings GDS, NDC and low-cost carrier fares into one search, so counter staff, online customers and sub-agents book from the same content with your markup applied automatically.

Unlike a standalone booking engine, the flight module is part of a complete travel agency ERP. Every issue, reissue, refund and void updates the passenger record, the agent ledger and your supplier payable in real time, which turns month-end BSP reconciliation into a report instead of a spreadsheet exercise.

Agencies in Bangladesh, Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Malaysia use it as their flight management software to run walk-in counters, white-label B2B portals and B2C websites from one back office, in their own currency and with local payment methods.
faqs: Which airline content can I sell?
You can connect Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport, airline NDC APIs, low-cost carriers and aggregators such as Duffel or TBO using your own supplier credentials.
Do I need my own IATA licence or GDS contract?
No. You can sell through a consolidator or ticketing partner's API, or connect your own IATA and GDS credentials if you have them. Many agencies start with a partner and add direct contracts later.
Can I sell NDC fares and low-cost airlines?
Yes. NDC and low-cost fares appear in the same search as GDS fares, so staff and agents compare every option in one list. What you can sell depends on the airlines and suppliers you connect.
Can B2B agents issue tickets themselves?
Yes. Agents book and issue from their portal using their wallet or credit limit, and you control which airlines and fares they see.
Does it handle refunds and reissues?
Yes. Refunds, reissues and voids are processed from the booking, with penalties and service fees posted to accounts automatically.
Is BSP reconciliation supported?
Yes. Ticket sales, refunds and ADMs are recorded per airline and billing period, so you can match them against your BSP billing and supplier statements.
Which currencies and payment methods are supported?
You can sell in BDT, USD, SAR, AED, MYR and more, and take payment by card, PayPal, Stripe, bKash, Nagad, SSLCommerz, bank transfer or agent wallet.
How long does it take to start selling flights?
Most agencies go live in two to four weeks. The main factor is how quickly your supplier credentials and certification are ready; we handle the setup and training.

seo.keywords: travel website CMS, travel agency content management system, travel website builder, travel blog CMS, SEO for travel agency website, menu builder travel website
overview: TravelSuite ERP includes a content management system made for travel agency websites. Pages, menus, images, blog posts, FAQs and testimonials are all managed from the same admin panel as your bookings, so marketing staff can update the site without a developer.

Content is built for search. Blog posts have meta titles, meta descriptions and a search preview, categories and tags, a feature image and a publishing workflow from draft and review to scheduled and published. Site-wide SEO settings cover the rest.

Design stays consistent too. Theme and header and footer settings control the look, details templates shape service pages, and the menu builder adds pages, categories and custom links to your navigation.
faqs: Do I need a developer to update the website?
No. Pages, menus, images, blog posts, FAQs and testimonials are edited from the admin panel.
Is the blog SEO-friendly?
Yes. Every post has a meta title, meta description and search preview, plus categories, tags and a feature image.
Can I schedule blog posts?
Yes. Posts move through draft, review, scheduled and published, so you can plan content ahead.
How do I change the menu?
Use the menu builder to add pages, categories and custom links, then save the order you want.
Where are images stored?
In the media library, with folders, favourites, duplicate detection, filters and a trash for deleted files.
Can I moderate blog comments?
Yes. Comments arrive in a moderation queue where you approve or remove them.
Can I show customer reviews?
Yes. Testimonials support a person, rating, text, optional video, featured flag and display order.
How is this different from the Agency Website feature?
Agency Website is the booking site your customers use. The Website CMS is how your team manages its content, design and SEO.

seo.keywords: passport OCR software, travel document OCR, passport scanner for travel agencies, visa application OCR, automatic data entry travel agency, Tesseract OCR travel ERP
overview: Document Intelligence brings OCR to TravelSuite ERP. Staff upload or scan a traveller's document, the system reads the text and fills in the matching fields, and the staff member only checks and saves. It works in modules such as Visa, Hotel, Tour and CRM.

The engine is Tesseract, running on your own server, with English and Bangla language support. You choose the confidence threshold, which document types are enabled and whether to keep the raw OCR text and logs. Support for Google Vision, Azure and AWS Textract is planned.

Every scan is recorded with its module, document type, reference, status, confidence and time. The dashboard groups scans by module and the logs show any errors, so managers can see how much typing OCR is saving and where documents need a second look.
faqs: What does Document Intelligence do?
It reads text from travel documents with OCR and fills in the matching form fields, so staff check instead of typing.
Which modules use it?
It works across modules such as Visa, Hotel, Tour and CRM, and the dashboard shows scans by module.
Which OCR engine is used?
Tesseract, self-hosted on your server. Google Vision, Azure and AWS Textract providers are planned.
Does it read Bangla?
Yes. Tesseract language codes such as eng, ben or eng+ben let you read English, Bangla or both.
How accurate is it?
Accuracy depends on image quality. Each scan has a confidence score and you set the threshold, so low-confidence results are flagged for review.
Is the scanned text stored?
You decide. Settings let you store or skip the raw OCR text and the OCR logs.
Can I see past scans?
Yes. Scan history lists the module, document type, reference, status, confidence and time of every scan.
Is Document Intelligence free?
The OCR module is included with TravelSuite ERP. Ask us during the demo how to switch it on.
